subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3670
title: Requires a company or state agency that diverts a body of water within 15 miles of high-value farmland to conduct a study to ensure that the diversion will not negatively impact the high-value farmland.
headline: HB 3670 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3670 was introduced in the House on February 25, 2025.
HB 3670 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
